create_TensorVM: create a TensorVM tensor factorization volume module for 3D scene representation with plane and line coefficients
create_TensorVMSplit: create a TensorVMSplit module with separate density and appearance plane line coefficients for 3D rendering
create_TensorCP: create a TensorCP canonical polyadic decomposition module using only line coefficients for density and appearance
create_MLPRender_PE: create an MLPRender_PE MLP rendering module with positional and view directional encoding for RGB output
create_AlphaGridMask: create an AlphaGridMask module to sample alpha values from a 3D volume using grid sampling
